mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_benefit_monthly_usage (user_card_id, benefit_service_name, target_year, target_year_month, used_amount, used_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{userCardId}, #{benefitServiceName}, #{targetYear}, #{targetYearMonth}, #{usedAmount}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE used_amount = used_amount + #{usedAmount}, used_count = used_count + 1, updated_at = NOW()
